scope: LDS public component entries and non-Foundation Storybook decision pages

visualReview.reasoning: The 15-section guide is generated to docs/components/guides/*.md and llms.txt, which is the long-form surface this score refers to. Storybook's Docs tab is not that surface and no longer pretends to be: it carries the four sections a reader needs while looking at the component — 사용 판단, Properties (states included), Accessibility, Tokens — and points at the generated guide for the rest. Reprinting the whole guide made a component viewer print 3,400px per page of which 63% also appeared on other pages; Button went 12,976px to 4,196px. Measured at 1440px and 390px with no page-level horizontal overflow, one title, one heading ramp and one block rhythm shared with Storybook's own blocks.

verification: A11Y_SHARD=1/4..4/4 npm run check:a11y (532 stories total)
knownDifferences: Existing prompt contracts intentionally retain some English API terminology, so prose language is not yet uniform on every guide.
LDS uses live component, type and token evidence instead of copying branded screenshots or product examples.
iOS and Android status remains not-tracked because this repository does not own those implementations.
